evidence.related: Related text · does not establish this field

factValidation.needsReviewTitle: This summary needs a fact check
factValidation.needsReviewDescription: The summary was generated and remains editable, but it conflicts with recorded meeting facts or those facts were unavailable.
factValidation.genericWarning: A recorded meeting fact could not be verified.
factValidation.missingMeetingContext: This meeting has no structured personnel and terminology context.
factValidation.meetingDateMismatch: The meeting date in the summary conflicts with the recorded meeting time.
factValidation.attendanceConflict: The attendee list includes someone not explicitly marked as attending.
factValidation.absenceConflict: The absence list conflicts with the recorded attendance state.
factValidation.hostConflict: The host in the summary conflicts with the recorded host.
factValidation.personNameConflict: The summary contains an unverified or mixed-up attendee name that requires review.
factValidation.missingTranscriptEvidence: No transcript was available for checking the summary's business facts.
factValidation.unsupportedTranscriptTerm: The summary contains an acronym or project name absent from both the transcript and the meeting dictionary.
factValidation.unsupportedYear: A year is absent from the transcript and verified context. Generated output marks it for review; human edits are preserved and need checking against the source.
factValidation.unsupportedAcronymExpansion: An acronym explanation is absent from the transcript and verified context. Generated output keeps the acronym without that explanation; human edits are preserved for review.
factValidation.unsupportedOrganization: An action-plan department, team, or group name could not be verified directly in the transcript.
factValidation.unsupportedStatusClaim: A definite status in the summary could not be matched to the same person, project, or business object in the transcript.
factValidation.unsupportedSecurityClaim: The summary introduced a security rule absent from the transcript and possibly copied from a template example; it was hidden and marked for review.
factValidation.untraceableActionOwner: An action owner has no exact supporting segment in the activated transcript and needs review.
factValidation.untraceableActionTime: An action time or deadline has no exact supporting segment in the activated transcript and needs review.
factValidation.untraceableActionDependency: An action dependency lacks explicit source evidence for that task. Check it in Source evidence.
factValidation.manualHighRiskFieldsUnverified: The manual edit preserves an owner, deadline, status, or other high-risk field that the transcript cannot verify.
factValidation.validationUnavailable: This summary could not be revalidated against the latest transcript and meeting context, so it must not be treated as fact-checked.
factValidation.summaryMarkdownUnavailable: This summary has no Markdown body that can be fact-checked, so it must not be treated as validated.
